gloss: luggage tag; baggage label; shipping tag

definitions.gloss: luggage tag; baggage label; shipping tag
definitions.explanation: A tag or label attached to luggage, packages, or cargo indicating the destination, contents, or owner.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}に{荷札|にふだ}を{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I attached a tag to the luggage.

examples.japanese: {荷札|にふだ}に{宛先|あてさき}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write the destination on the shipping tag.

examples.japanese: {引越|ひっこ}しの{荷物|にもつ}には{荷札|にふだ}を{付|つ}けておくと、{運|はこ}び{先|さき}が{分|わ}かりやすい。
examples.english: Putting tags on your moving boxes makes it easy to tell where they should go.

notes:
Composed of {荷|に} (cargo, load) + {札|ふだ} (tag, label). Used for any kind of label attached to packages, luggage, or shipped goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷札|にふだ}を{付|つ}ける — to attach a tag
- {荷札|にふだ}を{書|か}く — to write a tag
- {荷札|にふだ}を{外|はず}す — to remove a tag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- タグ — tag (loanword, general purpose)
- ラベル — label (loanword)
- {名札|なふだ} — name tag
- {値札|ねふだ} — price tag
